name: Hildelve's Journal
summary: Hildelve's Journal was recovered from the dwarf's remains in Dun Morogh. Its bloodstained pages recount a fatal meeting with a fierce bear and his last wish for vengeance.

sections.title: A Pilot's Final Words
sections.body: Dwarven pilot Hildelve set out alone into Dun Morogh after his steam tank broke down. He left his partner, Hammerfoot, with the tanks and went searching the snow-swept crags for rumored chiron ore. His journal says Mangeclaw, a monstrous ice claw bear, stalked him for days before ambushing him. Hildelve fought bravely and drove the bear off, but the beast mauled him, leaving him gravely wounded and stranded in the cold. His final hours were agonizing. Before the predator returned to finish him, Hildelve left one clear plea: whoever found his body should hunt Mangeclaw and avenge his death.

sections.title: Return to the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot, Hildelve's comrade, is stationed near North Gate Outpost in eastern Dun Morogh. A member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, Hammerfoot feared the worst when his partner failed to return from the search for ore. The journal and Mangeclaw's severed claw give Hammerfoot proof that Hildelve's final wish has been honored and his spirit put to rest.

faq.answer: Hildelve was a dwarf who piloted a steam tank for the Ironforge Siege Brigade. After his tank broke down, he went alone into Dun Morogh seeking chiron ore. Mangeclaw killed him before he could return.
Mangeclaw is an unusually large, savage ice claw bear that stalks Dun Morogh's snowy ridges. The bear ambushed Hildelve while he was stranded and mauled him severely, then returned to end his life.

faq.q: Who receives the journal once it is found?
aliases: where do i take the journal
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot receives the journal. He is a siege engine pilot and Hildelve's comrade, stationed near North Gate Outpost in eastern Dun Morogh. He had sought word of the missing pilot.

faq.q: What does Hildelve ask for in the journal?
faq.answer: Hildelve asks whoever finds his remains to hunt Mangeclaw and avenge his death. In the journal's final pages, he records the beast that attacked him and makes his plea, knowing his wounds are mortal.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can honor the unyielding spirit of pilots who brave freezing weather and wild beasts to secure the heights of Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance member, you strengthen the bond between the Alliance and the Ironforge Siege Brigade when you recover the personal effects of fallen soldiers like Hildelve.
